module: D09-13 Industry Structure／Porter Five Forces產業結構與波特五力
purpose: Test whether the BR-051 industry-structure contract generalizes outside semiconductors using Taiwan steel/basic-metals evidence.

sourcePanel.use: Official detailed-industry production-index and production/sales/inventory source family for Basic Metals and Smelting & Refining of Iron & Steel.
Issuer-native integrated blast-furnace/basic-oxygen-furnace process and imported iron-ore/coking-coal input path.
Issuer-native electric-arc-furnace, scrap-steel input and construction-steel product path; 2025 primary raw material approximately 98% scrap.

marketDefinition.officialStatisticalIndustry: MOEA / DGBAS Basic Metals -> Smelting & Refining of Iron & Steel
marketDefinition.listedCompanyTaxonomy: TWSE steel industry is broader than one economic product market
marketDefinition.researchBoundary: Do not treat all listed steel names as one homogeneous competitive market. Segment by production route, product family, customer/end-use and geography before market-share or force inference.

firmStructurePanel.name: 中鋼
firmStructurePanel.structuralRole: large integrated diversified flat/long steel producer with broad end-market/export exposure

firmStructurePanel.name: 東和鋼鐵
firmStructurePanel.structuralRole: scrap-based EAF long/construction steel producer with different raw-material and customer transmission

evidence: Integrated BF/BOF and scrap-based EAF producers have different cost curves and raw-material sensitivities.
Flat products, electrical steel, plate, rebar and structural steel are not one homogeneous economic product market.
Export-exposed integrated steel and domestically construction-linked EAF producers can face different demand regimes.
Integrated BF/BOF route requires coke/sinter/blast-furnace/converter/continuous-casting/rolling infrastructure and very large scale.
EAF route avoids the full integrated ironmaking chain but still requires furnace/rolling capacity, power, scrap procurement, environmental permits and product-quality qualification.

substitutes.evidence: Substitution depends on product/end use; this receipt does not freeze cross-price elasticity or a complete steel-vs-aluminum/concrete/composite substitution dataset.

evidence: CSC relies on imported iron ore and coal for the integrated route.
Tung Ho relies primarily on scrap steel and electricity, with 2025 primary raw material about 98% scrap.
CSC reports 55.8% domestic and 44.2% export product disposition.
Tung Ho products are concentrated in building/structural steel.
Comparable customer concentration, contract tenor and switching-power denominators are not frozen.

crossIndustryFalsification: The semiconductor-foundry 'high capex + qualification + process learning' barrier template cannot be copied verbatim to steel.
A single TWSE steel label does not imply a single raw-material beta: iron ore/coking coal and scrap/electricity exposures differ fundamentally.
High industry concentration or large producer scale does not establish common pricing power across flat steel, rebar, electrical steel and structural steel.
Lower-carbon EAF route does not mechanically imply superior margins or returns; scrap/electricity availability and construction demand can dominate.
Integrated scale can create cost/product advantages while also increasing fixed-cost and decarbonization-transition burden.

prohibited: CSC capacity / MOEA industry production index as market share
CSC revenue / MOEA production value without unit/scope reconciliation
Tung Ho scrap share as company market share or pricing-power proxy
denominatorFirewall.rule: Market share requires compatible numerator, denominator, product, geography, period and measurement unit. Otherwise UNKNOWN.

pitSemantics.firstEligibleDecision: No earlier than each official source publication/capture time.
pitSemantics.historicalBackfill: Current company descriptions may support current structural state but are not backfilled as unchanged historical truth.

reasonNoL4: Cross-industry generalization and falsification improved, but there is still no prospective/OOS test linking the structure state to future margins, returns, selection utility or multi-regime incremental value.
exactNext: BR-055 add a third structurally different Taiwan industry control such as PCB/ABF, power/thermal, or automotive electronics before any cross-industry structure scoring.
Freeze buyer/supplier concentration denominators where official or issuer-native data permit; otherwise retain UNKNOWN.
Do not create a composite Five-Forces score before prospective/OOS and redundancy tests.
